name: GPT Image 2 Edit
description: OpenAI's newest image model for editing with any-resolution support and improved quality

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Text prompt describing how to edit the image, max 4000 characters, required
fields.placeholder: Describe how you want to edit the image...

fields.name: uploadedImages
fields.description: Source images to edit, accepts up to 10 image uploads, required — Upload images to edit (max 10 images) — Use public HTTPS URLs only. If the harness gives a local path like /mnt/user-data/uploads/... or file://..., call upload_file first and use the returned permanent URL.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Output image dimensions with default Auto. Pick a preset or choose Custom to enter width x height. Custom size: width and height must each be 1024-3840 px, multiples of 16; long-to-short ratio <= 3:1; total pixels 655,360-8,294,400. Prefer a preset unless exact dimensions are required. For 1080p aspect output, use 1920x1088 or 1088x1920; do not use 1920x1080 because 1080 is not a multiple of 16. — For a custom value, do NOT pass "Custom" — instead set "size" directly to an object with numeric "width" and "height", e.g. {"width":1024,"height":1024}. Constraints: Custom size: width and height must each be 1024-3840 px, multiples of 16; long-to-short ratio <= 3:1; total pixels 655,360-8,294,400.

fields.name: quality
fields.description: Rendering quality level affecting detail and cost with default High, options are High, Medium, Low

fields.name: background
fields.description: Background transparency mode for the output image with default Auto, options are Auto, Opaque, Transparent. Transparent backgrounds require PNG or WebP output.

fields.name: n
fields.description: Number of images to generate with default 1, options are 1, 2, 3, 4

fields.name: output_format
fields.description: Output file format of the generated image with default PNG, options are PNG, JPEG, WebP.
